title: Option A PR 1: drop it, or reverse #309 and put EXPERIENCE_FIT back as fit evidence?
detail: PR 1 was to add EXPERIENCE_FIT back to FIT_KEYS in foreman-cockpit pipeline-evidence.js. #309 removed it on purpose: the viewer stopped treating a stored EXPERIENCE_FIT (a keyword proxy like 35/40) as role-fit evidence. Tests lock that in, so with the one-line change 4 of 1145 tests fail and the PR cannot self-merge on green. The Writer copy (apps-script/PipelineEvidence.gs:19) still has it, and the tests allow that gap on purpose.
blocks: PR 1 only. PRs 2 and 3 do not depend on it.
options: Drop PR 1 and keep #309 as is
Make the Writer match #309: remove EXPERIENCE_FIT from PipelineEvidence.gs
Reverse #309: add it back in the viewer and change #309's tests
recommended: Make the Writer match #309. Keyword-proxy numbers then stop counting as measured fit in both places, which fits the open P1 'Fit and flex values look filled-in, not assessed'.
action: Answer in chat; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
